BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Supreme Evil Crystal Beast!!
We're completely outmatched!!\nI guess we really need Grecia's light arrow to\ndefeat it...
However, Grecia is in another world and she is in\nthe Dark Realm, so there is no way to contact\nher...
Ugh! Let's see how you like thiiis!!
Ugh!!
Zianga!!
Aaaaah...I always thought a hero would come to\nsave the day in times of crisis...
Ayeee...we're done for!!
W-who are you?
We can talk about that later, no rush.\nNow is your chance anyway, are you really not\ngonna do anything?
The crystal monster has clearly become weaker.\nWe might be able to defeat it now!
Yeah...yaaas! We beat the crystal monster!!
Aye, yes, yessss!!
Hahaha, you're quite something!\nI know the monster got weaker, but still, the fact\nthat you managed to beat it is impressive!!
Huh? Except for that Lixi over there, you all are\nfrom the world I come from...I think this is our\nfirst time meeting.
I am the God of Peace in your world.\nMy name is Freedos. It's a pleasure to meet you...
Whoa...A god from our world who fell into this\nworld. I'm starting to lose count of how many\nI've met...
What's a God of Peace doing here?
The job of a God of Peace is to maintain peace.\nI roam this world to maintain balance and fix\nproblems that could disrupt harmony...
Maintain balance and fix problems?
Yeah, all sorts of things and problems. I suppose\nyour kind has its own issues with the dragonkin\nas well.
That means...\nWait, don't tell me you know where the royal\ndragon cocoon is...?
Hahaha, of course I know.\nBecause the royal dragon cocoon is with me!
Whaaaat?!
To Be Continued...
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back!
Explore this place a little longer!
Are you serious...?\nDo you really have the royal dragon cocoon with\nyou?
I am very serious...
Lend it to us then! We need it to power the vital\npoint of the weredragons to get rid of Coenubia!
Should I, though?\nYou know what I like? Perfect balance.
I hate the feeling of having something heavy in my\nright hand and something light in my left.\nI don't like it when things are out of balance.
I hate it even more if it happens because of my\nactions...The royal dragon cocoon is something\nthat requires careful attention.
What?! If we beat Coenubia, there'll be no more\nfighting and it'll be completely peaceful!\nThat's what the gods want too, right?!
Peace is not the same thing as balance...
Coenubia has become such a massive obstacle, and\ngetting rid of it takes more power than you have\nalone.
The spark in your eyes...\nUnlike your companions', yours seem a bit\ndifferent.
Is that guy really a god?
Well, he's got the look, but he seems like a\ngentle, somewhat unreliable guy~.
Maybe he's a fake?\nI also doubt that he really has the royal dragon\ncocoon.
So what are you gonna do about it?
Let's charge at him together at the same time and\npin him down!
You want to pin down a god?!
If he really has the royal dragon cocoon, we can\njust get down on our knees and beg for\nforgiveness!
Welp~, if he's real, he won't get pinned down by\nus easily, right?
Aye! I'mma beat that god too!
Alright! On my cue, everyone charge at him all\nat once!
I got this~!
Aye!
Oh!
Oh my gosh!
Ay ay ay?!
Stop it...Are you really gonna waste the life you\nwere lucky to keep, just like that?
Hey, what's your deal?! What are you to that god?!
I support what Freedos is trying to do and I'm\nhelping him with that.
...And of course, I'm protecting him.
Anyway, let's just say that you're not qualified\nto even glance at the  royal dragon cocoon now.
How annoying~!! Then why did you even bother\nshowing up in front of us?
Exactly!! Are you only here to brag about the\nroyal dragon cocoon?!
I'm the God of Peace...\nI always watch the world balance from a neutral\nperspective.
Therefore, when someone out of the ordinary\nappears, I tend to notice right away and feel\ncompelled to test their capabilities...
Well, I'd be happy if my hunch was right.
Ugh~!! That's awful!!\nHe's probably really a fake god!!
I think so too, but if he's real and he really has\nthe royal dragon cocoon, it'll be troublesome if\nwe continue to provoke him.
The ark should be coming back soon, right?\nShould we ask Kunon about that guy?
Aye! Kunon is a god! She must know a lot about\ngods.
Okay then, let's go see Kunon!\nThe ark should be back in Vanek Plains by now!!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
